metadata.title: English Word Search Puzzles by CEFR Level
metadata.description: 60 themed word search puzzles. Themes and vocabulary are calibrated to each CEFR level, and so is the grid: size, allowed word directions and the share of 'decoy' filler letters taken from the hidden words.
metadata.framework: CEFR (Common European Framework of Reference for Languages)

level_settings.grid: Rows and columns of the letter grid.
level_settings.directions: Allowed reading directions: right, down, down-right, up-right, left, up, down-left, up-left.
level_settings.decoyLetters: 0 to 1. Share of filler letters copied from the hidden words (higher = harder).
level_settings.listMode: What the word list shows by default: "words" or "clues" (definitions). Teachers can switch during class.
